# Burning Calendar: harmonized MODIS + VIIRS fire activity, Greece and Argentina

> Monthly active fire detection counts from NASA FIRMS for Greece (13 NUTS2 regions) and Argentina (24 provinces), November 2000 to December 2025, on one scale: VIIRS S-NPP 375 m equivalent detections. VIIRS counts are used as observed from 2012; earlier months are MODIS counts times a factor fitted per region, calendar month and day/night on 2012-2019. Each region also has a fire season calendar (peak month, onset, end, season length) and monthly anomalies against the preceding 10 years. Static JSON and CSV, no API key, CORS open.

Read before using the numbers:

- A region with `mode: "relative"` failed validation (leave-one-year-out annual error above 25 %, or the harmonized series missed the VIIRS peak month in at least two more held-out season years than raw MODIS). Its `harm` is null and its calendar and anomalies come from MODIS counts alone. Do not compare its counts with harmonized regions.
- Months with `src` `backcast` or `backcast_terra` (before 2012) are modelled, not observed. Quote them with the `harm_lo` to `harm_hi` range (10th to 90th percentile of out-of-sample errors).
- Counts are detections, not fires and not burned area. One fire can produce many detections.
- `outage: true` marks months with at least 3 days of known satellite data gaps.
- National validation: leave-one-year-out median absolute error of annual totals 5.4 % for Greece and 1.5 % for Argentina. The VIIRS/MODIS night ratio in Greece falls 3.3 % per year over 2012-2025, so back-cast night counts carry extra uncertainty.

## Data

- [Greece index](/data/v1/gr/index.json): all Greek regions with mode, climatology and validation summary
- [Argentina index](/data/v1/ar/index.json): all Argentine provinces, same fields
- [Region detail, JSON](/data/v1/gr/regions/EL52.json): pattern `/data/v1/{gr|ar}/regions/{id}.json`, monthly series, season years, factors, band, validation
- [Region detail, CSV](/data/v1/ar/regions/30.csv): pattern `/data/v1/{gr|ar}/regions/{id}.csv`, one row per month
- [Greece geometry](/data/v1/gr/regions.geojson): GeoJSON, property `id` matches the index
- [Argentina geometry](/data/v1/ar/regions.geojson): GeoJSON, IGN province id `in1` as `id`
- [Validation, Greece](/data/v1/gr/validation.json) and [Validation, Argentina](/data/v1/ar/validation.json): per-region LOYO, time split, ratio trend, mode reasons

## Web app and deep links

- [Map and calendar](/): interactive map, year x month heatmap, series toggle
- [Deep link example, Paraná Delta 2019-2020](/?country=ar&region=30&from=2019-12&to=2020-11): pattern `/?country=gr|ar&region={id}&from=YYYY-MM&to=YYYY-MM&series=harm|modis|viirs`; `series` defaults to `harm` and can be left out
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only, no auth): `https://burning-calendar.vercel.app/api/mcp`. Tools: `search_regions`, `rank_regions`, `aggregate`, `get_region_series`, `get_season_calendar`, `get_anomalies`, `compare_regions`, `find_region_at`, `get_methodology`. Every result carries `caveats` and a `view_url` deep link.

## Schemas

- [index.json schema](/data/v1/schema/index.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12
- [regions/{id}.json schema](/data/v1/schema/region.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12, field descriptions included

## Region ids

- Greece: `GR` (whole country), NUTS 2024 codes `EL30`, `EL41` to `EL43`, `EL51` to `EL54`, `EL61` to `EL65`
- Argentina: `AR` (whole country), IGN province codes, for example `06` Buenos Aires, `14` Córdoba, `18` Corrientes, `30` Entre Ríos (Paraná Delta)

## Optional

- Source data: NASA FIRMS standard processing archive, MODIS Collection 6.1 (Terra and Aqua) and VIIRS S-NPP 375 m, `type == 0` (presumed vegetation fire), cells with 16 or more detection days a year removed as static sources
- Boundaries: GISCO NUTS 2024 (Eurostat), IGN Argentina `ign:provincia`
